notes.title: 🔥 Witch Hunters V0.1.5 🔥
notes.content:
[h2][b]Added[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Diary: keep track of the clues you've discovered during your adventure, as well as the characters you've met.
[*] Access to certain clues can now be blocked depending on the player's actions or dice roll results.
[*] Ally discussion: different questions can be asked, with answers evolving over time.
[*] An additional zone has been added: the graveyard.
[/list]

[h2][b]Improved[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked lighting ambience for the keeping room.
[*] Text formatting to match the dialogue.
[*] Some clues found in the same place have been combined into a single clue with a more detailed description.
[*] The “Friend of the Missing” cover replaces the unclear 3rd cover option (The Missing).
[*] The end of the demo can now be triggered in several ways.
[*] Text changes: initial dialogue, entering the manor.
[*] Improved sound ambiance during certain dialogues.
[*] The first clue is obtained much earlier.
[*] Clue sprites updated.
[*] Sound ambiance at the end of the demo.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixed[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Character models.
[*] Character textures.
[*] Character rotation bugs.
[*] Some skills used during dice rolls have been modified to better match the action.
[*] Players are no longer teleported if they are already in the room corresponding to a premature end of game.
[*] Illumination of certain objects.
[*] Dialog to access Lady Margaret's office.
[*] Cursor sprite when opening a menu.
[*] Character selection navigation.
[*] History scroll bar in dialog.
[*] Multiple bugs corrected when using a joystick, including a blocking bug at the end of the first dialogue with Silas.
[*] Navigation in some interfaces allowed access to other menus.
[*] The move menu now appears behind the pause menu.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bugs[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Some rooms are too dark.
[/list]

[h2][b]Missing[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Credits
[*] Changed the default image of the movement window when a location is unknown to replace the black square.
[*] Highlighting of the object currently hovered over by the cursor.
[*] Redesigned map display for smoother navigation between locations.
[*] Character progression and evolution system.
[/list]

notes.title: 🔥 Witch Hunters V0.1.4 🔥
notes.content:
[h2][b]Added[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Paintings descriptions.
[*] Interaction dependent on the player character in the first discussion with Eleanor.
[*] More cases of credibility gain or loss.
[*] Additional scene added in case of high credibility loss.
[*] Interaction with the mirror in Lady Margaret's study.
[*] Additional interaction in Thomas's bedroom.
[*] Loss of health/mental health: several visual feedbacks added
[/list]

[h2][b]Improved[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Use of shortcuts rather than clicks for the “Search” and “Move” buttons.
[*] The map button opens the move menu.
[*] Brightness changed to make characters more visible. The lighting ambience is darker than in the previous version.
[*] Increased time allotted to choices with timer. (+1s)
[*] Character selection: lock displayed on Silas rather than next to it.
[*] NPC positions.
[*] Bold and underlined text added for important information.
[*] Some clues that also unlock an item now unlock only a clue.
[*] Management of the dialogue about the order in the discussion with Silas.
[*] Improved dinner scene.
[*] More pronounced zoom during dialogues and interactions with the environment.
[*] Notifications are displayed for longer periods (4s instead of 2s)
[*] Various texts.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixed[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Tutorial: text correction
[*] Move menu: room selection and associated image update on mouse-over.
[*] Fixed the bug that allowed access to Lady Margaret's desktop even in the event of failure.
[*] Corrected some texts that reproposed the same choices on subsequent inspection.
[*] Corrected Thomas' rotation after the dinner scene.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bugs[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Rotation bugs on some characters.
[*] If you play with a joystick, interactive elements may not update. We strongly advise you to play with the mouse and keyboard.
[*] In rare cases, a pnj may be incorrectly positioned during the dinner scene.
[*] (Very rare) End of demo->The player may be stuck in a room and not be able to teleport.
[/list]

[h2][b]Missing[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Credits
[*] Changed the default image of the movement window when a location is unknown to replace the black square.
[*] Highlighting of the object currently hovered over by the cursor.
[*] Text formatting according to the character speaking.
[/list]

notes.title: 🔥 Witch Hunters V0.1.2 🔥
notes.content:
[h2][b]Added[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Tutorial on health and mental health gauges.
[*] Damage management on certain choices.
[*] Addition of a early ending before entering the mansion.
[*] Credibility management for certain choices. Added notification when credibility changes. Trigger end of game if credibility decreases dramatically.
[*] Management of all success and failure levels for dice rolls before entering the mansion. Textual variations with emphasis on critical rolls and variations in damage and experience values.
[/list]

[h2][b]Improved[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated game time format on the game summary screen at the end of the game.
[*] Texts updated to subtly indicate before a choice that an option may have a particular consequence.
[*] Inventory appearance.
[*] Tutorial: Updating texts for better understanding.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixed[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Trigger sounds when taking damage.
[*] Fixed audio when returning to main menu.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented you from restarting a game after returning to the main menu.
[/list]

[h2][b]Missing[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Credits
[/list]
